Bettina Kroll, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused me with a missing-credentials error ("gateway cron.add requires credentials"), so no recurring job exists and nothing will post at 08:00 on Monday 19 Oct.

This needs someone with admin access to the OpenClaw gateway to fix its scheduler credentials. Once that's done, I can create the job with these settings:
- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 Central, first run Monday 19 Oct.
- **Where:** a post in #coastal-team.
- **What:** last week's messages from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. The customer items would cover ticket numbers, contacts and other operational facts, and leave out any pricing or other finance figures.
- **Who sees it:** both channels have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing from #coastal-random would reach anyone who can't already read it. I'd keep anything from DMs out.

I can also post a one-off digest now from the last week's messages, if you want one in the meantime.
